stage_deadline_rule: deadline_ms is the absolute monotonic deadline of the stage's serial_budget_phase; every stage in one phase shares that deadline and cannot reset or borrow outer scheduling slack
input_digest_rule: sha256(domain-utf8 || 0x00 || canonical-array-utf8), where domain is agenterm.singleton-safety.v1.frozen-input and canonical-array is the RFC 8785 encoding of an ordered array of [logical-member-id, sha256] pairs in exact input_digest_members order; a persisted raw path never enters a pair

record_identity_rules.kind_and_ordinal: must equal the artifact_mapping entry selected for this attempt
record_identity_rules.run_id: must satisfy run_id and equal the reserved ledger identity
record_identity_rules.source_sha256: receipt and ledger must equal the frozen source commit
record_identity_rules.input_digest: receipt and ledger must equal the frozen input digest
record_identity_rules.journal_identity: every journal row must equal the same experiment, kind, ordinal and run_id

ledger_row_rules.reserved: receipt_sha256 and terminal_code must both be JSON null
ledger_row_rules.finished: terminal_code must be a terminal_codes value; receipt_sha256 must be sha256 except for INCONCLUSIVE_EVIDENCE_PERSISTENCE, where it must be JSON null
ledger_row_rules.abandoned: receipt_sha256 must be JSON null and terminal_code must be attempt_abandoned_after_independent_audit

journal_row_rules.sequence: safe integer beginning at zero and increasing by exactly one
journal_row_rules.facts: exact subset of common_stage_facts plus the reached stage required and optional whitelist
journal_row_rules.publication: RFC 8785 canonical JSON followed by atomic replacement, readback and byte equality

receipt_rules.stage_statuses: exact object with every stage_order key and a stage_status_values value
receipt_rules.criteria: exact object with every criteria_keys key and a criterion_result_shape value
receipt_rules.scan: exact receipt_sections.scan object; when complete is true every nullable field is non-null; when complete is false a nullable field is null exactly when the corresponding measured fact is unavailable and is never synthesized as zero
receipt_rules.scan_source: receipt.scan and the scan-coverage stage derive from the same validated process-probe summary; every same-named field present in both is exactly equal, and a failed scan-coverage stage omits unavailable optional stage facts while receipt.scan retains their required keys as JSON null
receipt_rules.sample_sequence_digest: sha256 of the UTF-8 domain agenterm.singleton-safety.v1.sample-sequence, one 0x00 byte, and the RFC 8785 canonical JSON ordered sanitized sample array; zero samples uses the literal empty array and does not prove coverage
receipt_rules.journal_sha256: sha256 of the exact authoritative journal file bytes after final atomic readback
receipt_rules.publication: RFC 8785 canonical JSON followed by atomic replacement, readback and hashing before any lane mirror

criterion_result_types.code: JSON null or exactly one terminal_codes value

criterion_result_rules.failed: code must be exactly one failure_codes value frozen for that criterion
criterion_result_rules.not-run: the entire criterion value must be the literal string not-run, never an object, null, omission or inferred state

stage_pass_rules.presence_default: every pass_required fact must be present with a value valid for its declared type; exact_values and relational_values add constraints after this presence-and-type requirement
stage_pass_rules.boolean_default: every boolean-valued required or pass_required fact must be true
relational_values: scan-coverage.minimum_sample_count equals floor(window_duration_ms divided by limits.scan_interval_max_ms)
relay.candidate_observed_count equals classified_relay_count plus topology_candidate_count plus live_g1_exemption_count

runtime_reached_stage_rules.forward_prefix: the reached stages are a prefix of stage_order after removing kind_excluded_stages[kind], beginning at the first non-excluded stage
runtime_reached_stage_rules.tail_rule: every cleanup/persistence tail stage that is not kind-excluded is always reached; forward adjudication stops at the first forward stage that failed and no later forward stage is reached
runtime_reached_stage_rules.kind_exclusion_rule: kind_excluded_stages[kind] are never reached and never appear in any reached set
runtime_reached_stage_rules.hole_rule: after the first absent forward stage, no later forward stage may be present

envelope.rule: success requires ok=true plus object-or-array data and no error; failure requires ok=false plus an exact error object and no data

windows_filtered.rule: the object reply enumerates windows/visited/matched/returned/offset/truncated; there is no total key

shape.handle: nonnegative integer window handle from the public windows inventory row
shape.start_identity: nonempty string exactly as public process-state returns it for that pid

window_identity_preimage.rule: stable handle plus the owning process's public exact start identity; no title, geometry, z-order or other volatile field enters the preimage
window_identity_preimage.join_rule: the runner joins windows.process_id to process-state.start_identity for that exact pid; a pid whose start identity is unavailable is not digestable and fails closed

criterion_dependency_rules.v5_failure_exception: a previously persisted positive G1, G2 or G5 failure remains failed and keeps its typed code

value_type_rules.typed_code: stage_pass or exactly one terminal_codes value
value_type_rules.deviation_code_array: lexicographically sorted unique array containing only deviation_code_values
